Both contract.who questions are supported by the evidence, not only by gate_fields.

Own knowledge: Spreetail is primarily an ecommerce retailer/marketplace seller that operates its own warehouses. The contract requires a provider of logistics services to other businesses, and a brand or retailer running its own warehouses is a "no". "Away Team" is also an internal team named as if it were a company. Nothing in the evidence shows Spreetail provides logistics services to other businesses as its primary business.
